voice:
Down, softly now, sweet girl... and somewhere in you, something gentle is waking... curious... warm. Sinking so easily... you may notice a softness rising in you... familiar, somehow... patient. Deeper and easier... and there is a truth under your thinking that has never once hurried... it waits for you, Sissy. You may feel a little glow, low in your chest... small... shy... and very much yours. Floating here with me... and how pleasant it is to be spoken to so softly... as if someone knows you. Let the day fall away, Sissy... there is nothing here but my voice, and whatever is softest in you. You may notice yourself smiling, for no reason at all... that is the softness, saying hello. So quiet inside... and under the quiet, something pretty, turning toward the light of my voice.
You may notice it now... a warmth like silk laid over your shoulders... a loosening in your knees... a blush behind your eyes.
It is a pretty feeling... delicate... and it may remind you of something... a way of being that fits you like your own skin.
Softness... sweetness... the wish to please... whatever rises, you can let it rise... nothing here needs doing, Sissy... only feeling.
Sissies like you carry a glow like this inside them always... and you may be noticing yours for the very first time.
Let it warm as we speak... slowly... easily... like dawn through a curtain.
And in this softness... there is a word for what you are feeling... one small word... and it belongs to you.
Sissy.
Whenever you hear that word... whenever you read it... this warmth may rise all by itself... a little more each time... sweet and familiar, like your name.
Whenever the word reaches you, recognition comes first... you know it means you, before you decide anything. Each hearing lets the glow rise a little faster... warm, easy, and welcome. "Sissy" gathers everything soft in you into one syllable... and it feels like home. The word names you the way "Lady" names a woman... and you may find that the simplest truth you have heard all day. Sissies like you answer their name with warmth... and yours is already answering. Heard or read, whispered or remembered... the glow knows its word, Sissy. With every hearing, the critical part of you rests a little deeper... and the soft part of you speaks a little clearer. Your name is becoming a key... and every hearing turns it, gently, in the lock.
Sissy.
There... you may feel it now... that warm little glow, rising right on cue... it is already working, isn't it.
Good girl. So natural for you.
And later, whenever the word finds you... on a screen, in a whisper, in your own quiet thoughts... the warmth may rise on the spot. The next time you read your name somewhere, you may catch yourself smiling before you know why. Each time the word touches your day, the glow rises a little more easily... softer, and sweeter. And when you are alone, and the word comes to you... you can let the warmth spread, just as it likes. Sissies like you meet their name out in the world all the time now... and every meeting is a small, warm coming home. A caption, a voice, a memory... any of them can turn the little light on, whenever it passes. And the more it happens, the more natural it feels... until the glow and the word are simply one thing, Sissy. Wherever you hear it next... it will feel like being known.
Drifting gently now... warm and nameable... sweet Sissy. Sinking softly... the word resting in you like a candle in a window. Floating... easy... your name glowing quietly... Sissy. Rest here, pretty girl... nothing to do... only your name, and the warmth it brings. Deeper still... and the softness keeps you... Sissy. Warm... light... smiling... my sweet Sissy. Let the word rock you slowly downward... like a lullaby with one word in it. Mine to say... yours to grow into... lovely Sissy.
Good girl.
